item.title: Treasury rules out further VAT reforms for taxi and private hire sector following recent TOMS clampdown
item.description: The Government has signalled that no further reforms are planned to the VAT treatment of taxi and private hire vehicle services, following a Parliamentary question on whether additional changes were under consideration.Responding in a written answer, Exchequer Secretary to the Treasury Dan Tomlinson confirmed that private hire vehicle (PHV) services supplied by VAT registered businesses remain subject to the standard rate of VAT at 20 percent, a position he said has always applied.The response w

item.title: Wiltshire Police appeal after taxi driver racially abused during passenger pickup
item.description: Wiltshire Police has launched an appeal for witnesses following a racially aggravated incident involving a taxi driver in Tidworth.According to a police spokesperson, the incident occurred at around 11.30pm on 27 December 2025 outside the British Legion Tidworth. The driver was collecting a group of six people when he was subjected to racial abuse.Police said the victim was carrying out a routine passenger collection at the time. item.title: Cashless payment mandate set to reshape taxi and PHV operations in South Oxfordshire and Vale of White Horse
item.description: Taxi and private hire vehicle drivers operating in South Oxfordshire and the Vale of White Horse look set to face a significant operational change under proposals to mandate card and mobile payment acceptance across the licensed fleet from 1 January 2027. item.title: TRAGIC COLLISION: Names released of four dead after early-morning collision in Bolton involving taxi
item.description: Greater Manchester Police have confirmed the identities of four men who died following a serious collision involving a taxi on Wigan Road in Bolton in the early hours of Sunday 11 January 2025.Officers were called to the incident at around 12.45am after a red Seat Leon collided with a Citroen C4 Picasso operating as a taxi. item.title: Fresh Uber strike proposed later this week as some drivers look to extend January action over pay concerns
item.description: Private hire drivers are being urged to take part in a further nationwide strike against Uber later this week, extending a campaign that began with action on 12 January.The latest call, circulated widely on social media, asks drivers to log out of ride-hailing apps from 6am to 7pm on Friday 16 January in protest at what organisers describe as worsening pay and pricing conditions.The proposed action has received public backing from Private Hire and Taxi Monthly (PHTM), which has encouraged driver

item.title: Watford launches taxi tariff consultation for 2026 with revised fare structure proposed
item.description: Watford Borough Council has launched a statutory consultation on proposed changes to its Hackney Carriage Table of Fares, setting out revised tariffs that would apply from 2026 if approved.The consultation, issued under section 65 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976, covers all licensed hackney carriage vehicles operating in Watford and applies to both standard vehicles carrying up to five passengers and larger vehicles licensed for six passengers or more.Under the propos

item.title: DEEMED INADEQUATE: Taxi industry delivers overwhelming response to Government plans around cross-border working
item.description: Taxi drivers and private hire operators have delivered a largely critical verdict on the Government’s latest proposals to address cross-border working, with many arguing that the plans fail to confront the operational reality driving the problem.The feedback, gathered from across the trade, reveals widespread frustration that the proposals stop short of introducing direct controls on how private hire bookings are dispatched.
